descriptions.zh: 您在新建AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例时，可以通过该接口查询目标地域及可用区下可用的vSwitch信息。
descriptions.en:
When you create AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances, you can call this operation to query the details of vSwitches within a specified region or zone.

## Limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb describe-rds-vswitchs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp0000000000000000000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
